proposal.reason: Main change is review-routing automation behavior: .github/workflows/review-routing.yml now normalizes pr_number with fromJSON(format(...)) at the reusable-workflow boundary, fixing manual routing dispatch input typing. .github/scripts/reviewer_api.py independently changes workflow diagnostics by extending GitHubError and extracting/redacting/truncating HTTP error details (message/errors) for reviewer-invitation sync failures. These are contribution/review workflow policy-automation mechanics, so workflow is the most specific owner; no separate CI/build/runtime module behavior or contract is substantively changed.
